html: In junior high I bought a Jay Chou album on cassette and found that the songs on side A were all wailing and howling, while the songs on side B were all lovely. Only later did I find out that side B was all songs from Tiger Hu’s album Wenwu Shuangquan ;). My favorite was this one, “Tell Me,” and I still dig it out to listen to all the time. Of course, I later came to like Jay Chou more; it’s just that back then, Jay’s songs took a long time to sink in before I really loved them, whereas Tiger Hu’s songs were catchy right away.
